sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.body: Artificer - Board Game (Games, goal $30,516). The committee recommends Do Not Invest at 78% confidence.

sections.title: Market Opportunity
sections.body: Positive (score 72/100). Games campaigns fund at 44% vs a 40% platform baseline (lift 1.09). Market timing is favorable; the Games trend is rising (22,878 campaigns). The category is crowded.

sections.title: Competitive Position
sections.body: Negative (score 17/100). Ask for less: funded campaigns' median goal is $5,000 vs $10,000 for those that failed. Your $30,516 goal is 6.1x the winners' median ($5,000) — priced like the campaigns that failed. Category is crowded — 22,878 campaigns (9% of all).

sections.title: Founder Analysis (creator execution)
sections.body: Negative (score 36/100). The creator left ~42 points of controllable upside unrealized (24% of a reachable 66%) — craft gaps below. Craft gap: Shorten your campaign from 29 to 15 days (~30 pts). Craft gap: Lower your funding goal from $30,516 to $5,000 (~12 pts).

sections.title: Financial Analysis (funding viability)
sections.body: Negative (score 24/100). Goal $30,516 is 6.1x the category winners' median ($5,000). Calibrated funding probability 24% vs the 33% decision bar. Goal-size risk (High): Goal $30,516 is 6.1x the Games funded-median ($5,000); large goals are harder to reach.

sections.title: Risk Assessment
sections.body: Negative (score 27/100). Overall risk: High. Modeled failure risk 76%. High — Goal $30,516 is 6.1x the Games funded-median ($5,000); large goals are harder to reach. High — Modeled failure risk 76% (funding probability 24%, below the 33% threshold). 3 investor objection(s) raised; top: goal_size.

sections.title: Investment Thesis
sections.body: The committee recommends Do Not Invest at 78% confidence. Bull case (Market): Games campaigns fund at 44% vs a 40% platform baseline (lift 1.09). Bear case (Competition): Ask for less: funded campaigns' median goal is $5,000 vs $10,000 for those that failed. As presented the campaign is not fundable (24%), but it is fixable — reachable to ~66% with the priority pre-launch changes. Conditional on those fixes the thesis could clear the bar; unchanged, pass.
